name: diag-dip-cal2
description: Twin of diag-dip with every entry calibrated on 600 of its own games at DEPTH 2 instead of the experiment's depth-1 own calibration (theory-2 6.7, cause (3)): if the dip versions' ply-2 deficit closes towards their ply-1 gap, the dip is the depth-1 calibration of a young split applied at ply 2. Entries are model files, not versions (arena.py gives version entries their experiment's calibration, so the depth-2 calibration applies only to file entries; changed 11-11 ~00:30).
